name: realgame-dev-hooks
description: Repo tooling: git hooks, Cloudflare deploy (wrangler) and the analytics Functions tests. The game itself lives in crates/ and web/.

scripts.dev:pages: npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.analytics:purge: wrangler d1 execute realgame-analytics --remote --command "DELETE FROM events WHERE day < date('now', '-89 days')"
